archive.notes: Deterministic archive produced by `python framework/BaronyModLoader/app/barony_mod_loader.py package pack mods/stash --out framework/BaronyModLoader/fixtures/Stash-0.1.0.bmlpkg`.

runtime.notes: The v1 runtime path is the BML-owned installed-binary hook/bootstrap contract. Stash remains fail-closed because the required behavior-changing gameplay detour set is not installed yet.

hookLibrary.notes: The hook library can load, report, pass the fake-symbol absolute-jump detour self-test with near-target trampoline allocation, relocated RIP-relative cmp displacement, relocated short conditional branch call-through, classify decoder-safe Stash target prologues including REX-prefixed callee-saved push/register-move windows, non-RIP-memory and RIP-relative ModRM windows, terminal returns that exactly complete the patch window, relative-control-flow windows, movzx/multi-byte NOP, pxor, and lea prologue instructions, pass an opt-in fake-symbol Entity::addItemToVoidChestServer detour call-through self-test, and write a separate opt-in Entity::addItemToVoidChestServer pass-through install report while Stash remains fail-closed until behavior-changing detours are installed and verified in game.

hookManifest.notes: Pins Steam app/build, Linux platform, game version, executable hash/build id, symbol probes, and fail-closed Stash hook targets.

runtimeInfo.notes: Fixture declares installed-binary-hook policy and rejects partial Stash loads.

runtimeProvenance.notes: Release provenance is now the installed Steam/Linux executable plus BML hook artifacts, not a patched Barony source build.

compatibility.notes: The current release target is Steam/Linux app 371970 build 22630456. Playable Stash compatibility is still pending function detours and in-game verification.

patches.notes: Historical source patch retained as design reference; it is not the primary v1 runtime provenance path.
Historical source-level Stash hook reference; gameplay release support must come through installed-executable hook targets.

patchSeries.notes: Patch files remain checksummed semantic/source references only. The primary v1 release provenance is runtimeProvenance.installed-binary-hook.

buildArtifacts.notes: No patched/source-built Barony executable is claimed for this v1 release manifest. The installed Steam executable identity is recorded under runtimeProvenance.installedExecutable.

artifactVerification.notes: Release artifact provenance is present for the installed Steam/Linux hook path.

reports.notes: Runtime load reporting is the canonical hook-load report path for profiles.
Symbol probing can identify required Steam/Linux symbols without claiming gameplay hooks are installed.

The native hook smoke runs with BML_DETOUR_SELF_TEST=1 and validates the fake-symbol absolute-jump detour, near-target trampoline allocation, relocated RIP-relative cmp displacement, relocated short conditional branch prologue, and trampoline call-through.

The native hook smoke runs with BML_STASH_DETOUR_SELF_TEST=1 and validates an opt-in fake-symbol Entity::addItemToVoidChestServer detour plus trampoline call-through without claiming in-game Stash behavior.

The native hook smoke runs with BML_STASH_INSTALL_ADD_ITEM_PASSTHROUGH=1 and validates an opt-in process-lifetime pass-through detour install for Entity::addItemToVoidChestServer while runtime-load-report still contains BML_STASH_HOOKS_NOT_INSTALLED for the incomplete Stash hook set.

Required Stash targets currently report not_installed with a conservative static/readiness split (34 ready, 0 blocked, 0 missing for Steam/Linux build 22630456) and failClosed=true until the behavior-changing hook set is implemented.

installedHookVerification.notes: Current status is intentionally non-playable: Stash activation must fail closed with BML_STASH_HOOKS_NOT_INSTALLED or equivalent target-level detour-unavailable codes.

requiredScenarios: persistent Void Chest inventory across death, new run, and process relaunch
save/resume without duplicate or forked stash state
disabled package leaves vanilla Void Chest behavior unmodified
builtGameBehavior.notes: These scenarios remain pending until behavior-changing installed-executable function detours are implemented and verified in-game.

rollback.notes: Rollback means disabling the jml.stash package and launching the installed Barony executable without the BML hook/bootstrap environment.
steps: Disable jml.stash in the profile package state before launch.
Launch the installed Steam Barony executable without LD_PRELOAD or BML hook environment variables.
Preserve BaronyModLoader profile state, hook reports, and stash inventory files for inspection; do not delete user data unless explicitly requested.
Regenerate launch/runtime manifests after the package is disabled so stale capability metadata and hook provenance are not reused.
rollback.risk: Existing experimental stash state may be unreadable by vanilla Barony or later hook revisions; preserve it separately rather than silently converting or deleting it.
